description: You are an OHS Specialist reviewing air monitoring results from a manufacturing facility. A recent industrial hygiene survey measured airborne concentrations of 6 chemicals across 6 work zones. Some readings may exceed OSHA Permissible Exposure Limits (PELs) or approach IDLH values. One worker in Zone 4 has reported peripheral neuropathy symptoms. Using the air monitoring report at ~/Desktop/air_monitoring_report.txt and CAMEO Chemicals, you must: (1) look up OSHA PEL and IDLH for each chemical, (2) identify which zones have exceedances, (3) determine which chemical is most likely causing the worker's neurological symptoms, and (4) produce a written exceedance report with recommended corrective actions at ~/Documents/exposure_exceedance_report.txt.

metadata.within_limit_zone1: Toluene (185 ppm vs PEL 200 ppm — within limit)
metadata.within_limit_zone6: PERC (38 ppm vs PEL 100 ppm — within limit)
metadata.neuropathy_mechanism: n-Hexane metabolized to 2,5-hexanedione which causes peripheral neuropathy
